# Spring-NWVMC (`0.1.0` — Official Maven Central)

> Enterprise declarative REST, GraphQL, persistence, RBAC/ABAC security, resilience, and observability starter for **Java 21 LTS** and **Spring Boot 3.x** (`io.github.natswarchuan:spring-nwvmc:0.1.0` on Maven Central; GitHub Pages Docs: https://natswarchuan.github.io/Spring-NWVMC-document/). Declare a JPA `@Entity` extending `BaseAuditEntity` in `entity/` and an `@AutoRestController` interface extending `AutoApiController<E>` (or narrow composable interfaces `AutoReadApi<E>`..`AutoAiApi<E>`) in `controller/` to expose 40 standardized REST/streaming/schema/AI endpoints with optional `@ServiceOverride` escape hatches and MVC code ejection.

## Critical Anti-Hallucination Facts (Read First)

- **Artifact (Maven Central):** `io.github.natswarchuan:spring-nwvmc:0.1.0` (no custom repository needed; optional JitPack mirror: `com.github.NatswarChuan:Spring-NWVMC:v0.1.0`); requires Java 21 + `<parameters>true</parameters>` in `maven-compiler-plugin`.
- **6 Exact Annotation Packages (60 annotations, 133 attributes):** `io.github.natswarchuan.core.annotation.*` (54), `io.github.natswarchuan.module.cache.http.annotation.HttpCacheable`, `io.github.natswarchuan.module.datasource.annotation.{TargetDataSource, TargetDatabasePlatform}`, `io.github.natswarchuan.module.event.annotation.PublishCloudEvent`, `io.github.natswarchuan.module.lock.annotation.DistributedLock`, `io.github.natswarchuan.module.webhook.annotation.EntityWebhook`.
- **Never use `@Data` on JPA `@Entity`** and **never invent `@SoftDelete`** (UUIDv7 `id`, soft-delete, audit columns, `@Version` optimistic locking are inherited from `BaseAuditEntity`).
- **`@StateMachine.transitions`** uses **colon syntax** (`"CREATED:PENDING_PAYMENT,CANCELLED"`), never `"FROM -> TO"`. Trigger transitions with query param `POST /api/v1/{entity}/{id}/transition?targetState=PENDING_PAYMENT` (never JSON body).
- **Query filter operators** use **dot syntax** (`retailPrice.gte=1000&productName.like=MacBook`), never `__gte`.
- **CamelCase routes:** `ECommerceOrder` maps to `/api/v1/e-commerce-orders`.
- **Bean ordering & AOP:** Inject framework `@AutoComponent` helpers via `ObjectProvider<T>` (`.getObject()` at call time). Mark AOP-intercepted consumer `@Service` beans (`@DistributedLock`, `@AutoCacheable`, `@AutoCacheEvict`, `@TargetDataSource`) as **non-final** + **`@Lazy`** (with class-level `@TargetDataSource` for `REPLICA` on `v0.1.0`), AND inject them via `ObjectProvider<MyService>` or `@Lazy` in consumer callers. Never place `@Transactional` on `public final class` Helpers.
- **Dev JWT & Testing:** Dev token endpoint is `POST /api/v1/auth/token?username=admin&role=ROLE_ADMIN` (`200 OK`, `data.token`); `JwtTokenService.generateToken(username, userId, roles)` takes `username` FIRST.
- **Production lockdown:** Keep `app.framework.studio.enabled: false`, `demo-token-endpoint-enabled: false`, `fail-fast-weak-jwt-secret: true`, and `JWT_SECRET >= 32` UTF-8 bytes in `application.yml` / `application-prod.yml`.
